inputs.commit_message: chore: inspect local p2p-link R2 updater
inputs.shell_command: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=/home/hesham/p2p-link; echo '=== P2P-LINK LOCAL INSPECTION ==='; test -d "$ROOT"; cd "$ROOT"; echo '--- identity ---'; pwd; hostname; echo '--- git ---'; git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true; git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; git remote -v 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#(https?://)[^/@]+@#\1[redacted]@#g' || true; echo '--- top-level ---'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './node_modules/*' -printf '%p\n' | sort | head -300; echo '--- package scripts ---'; if [ -f package.json ]; then node -e 'const p=require("./package.json"); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts||{},null,2))'; fi; echo '--- env file names and variable names only ---'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '.env*' -o -name '*env' \) -not -path './node_modules/*' -print | sort | while read -r f; do echo "[$f]"; sed -n -E 's/^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=.*/\2/p' "$f" | sort -u; done; echo '--- relevant tracked files ---'; git grep -Il -E 'R2|Cloudflare|wrangler|3600|hour|cron|OnCalendar|OnUnitActiveSec|S3Client|PutObject|upload|publish|rendezvous|WAN|LAN|public.?ip|server.?data|peer' -- ':!*.lock' ':!package-lock.json' 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true; echo '--- relevant source excerpts (sensitive-looking lines suppressed) ---'; for f in $(git grep -Il -E 'R2|Cloudflare|wrangler|3600|hour|cron|OnCalendar|OnUnitActiveSec|S3Client|PutObject|upload|publish|rendezvous|WAN|LAN|public.?ip|server.?data|peer' -- ':!*.lock' ':!package-lock.json' 2>/dev/null | head -30); do echo "### $f"; git grep -n -E 'R2|Cloudflare|wrangler|3600|hour|cron|OnCalendar|OnUnitActiveSec|S3Client|PutObject|upload|publish|rendezvous|WAN|LAN|public.?ip|server.?data|peer' -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -120 || true; done; echo '--- systemd timers/services mentioning p2p/r2/link/peer ---'; systemctl --user list-timers --all --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'p2p|r2|link|peer|server' || true; systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'p2p|r2|link|peer|server' || true; echo '--- user cron ---'; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' || true; echo '--- system cron matches ---'; grep -RniE 'p2p-link|p2p|R2|r2|peer' /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.daily 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -100 || true; echo '--- candidate unit definitions ---'; for u in $(systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -iE 'p2p|r2|link|peer' | head -20); do echo "### user:$u"; systemctl --user cat "$u" 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' || true; done; for u in $(systemctl list-unit-files --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -iE 'p2p|r2|link|peer' | head -20); do echo "### system:$u"; systemctl cat "$u" 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' || true; done; echo '=== END INSPECTION ==='
